title: Concern Over Surge in Million-dollar HDB Resale Flat Transactions
what_it_is: Concern Over Surge in Million-dollar HDB Resale Flat Transactions

sections.label: Resale flat prices and grants
sections.summary: About 6% of resale flats sold above $1 million in 2025, with cheaper options in some towns and grants up to $230,000 for first-time buyers.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Chee Hong Tat)
sentences.text: In 2025, about 6% of resale flats transacted above $1 million.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Chee Hong Tat)
sentences.text: The resale market continues to provide a wide range of flats at different price points, catering to different budgets and needs.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Chee Hong Tat)
sentences.text: In 2025, there were 4-room resale flats with leases of 70 years or longer in Tampines and Punggol going for around $650,000 to $700,000.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Chee Hong Tat)
sentences.text: In Sembawang and Yishun, such flats were available below $600,000.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Chee Hong Tat)
sentences.text: In Jurong West and Woodlands, there were options below $550,000.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Chee Hong Tat)
sentences.text: For eligible first-time resale buyers, HDB provides housing grants of up to $230,000, further reducing the amounts they need to pay.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Chee Hong Tat)
sentences.text: We expect the resale market to continue to moderate due to a robust supply of new Build-To-Order (BTO) flats, including Shorter Waiting Time flats, and a larger number of flats finishing their minimum occupation period (MOP) and entering the resale market from this year 2026, and we will see further increases in 2027 and 2028.

sentences.speaker: Mr Abdul Muhaimin Abdul Malik (Sengkang)
sentences.text: Second, several Members of Parliament have spoken about the income ceiling for BTO eligibility, which has remained at $14,000 since 2019.
